kit.why: Q4: the runtime lane's mail ack (+43), the engine lane's subagents and shared rises, less the chains checkpoint cut and the single guard hook builder, plus Node's real path for the guard hook under a Bun-compiled Pi; Q5: the built-in lead resolves through Pi OAuth logins only (+5), and SendMessage finds an agent a reopen left off the roster in the durable store (+10); bench: Monitor says an Agent or Workflow already notifies, and ListAgents tells a lead with running tasks to end its turn instead of polling (+3); bench: SendMessage to a workflow id names the session's workflows and says they take no messages (+3); bench: subagents retry a 429 or 5xx 5 times, about 62 s, and wf-null-on-failure counts the retries (+1); bench: in print and json mode, job_start without a timeout and Monitor say Pi exits when the turn ends and will not wait for them (+6)

Measured after Q3: the plan's 4,000 predates workflow agent() running claude: and codex: models as CLI workers, the persisted SendMessage queue and the slots reserved for runs resumed after a restart; Q3 added the review fixes (print mode waits for reports, a run that throws reports failed, Outbox and 14-day store pruning, monitor and URL caps, the resume gate Mission waits on) and about 40 lines of imports splitting engine/index.ts into host.ts and workflow.ts; Q5 (+5): the built-in lead resolves through Pi OAuth logins only, so OPENAI_API_KEY never moves a session onto API billing; SendMessage finds an agent a reopen left off the roster (older than the 20 finished most recently started) in the durable store and resumes it, as its description promises (+10); bench: Monitor says an Agent or Workflow already notifies, and ListAgents tells a lead with running tasks to end its turn instead of polling (+3); bench: SendMessage to a workflow id names the session's workflows and says they take no messages (+3); bench: subagents retry a 429 or 5xx 5 times, about 62 s, and wf-null-on-failure counts the retries (+1); bench: in print and json mode, job_start without a timeout and Monitor say Pi exits when the turn ends and will not wait for them (+6)

polygon.why: Q4: the census waits up to 3 s for pane processes Herdr has just killed (2 lines); everything-at-once (50 lines, asserting each task's outcome and the steer) is the M7 gate, narrower than the plan's row: reload, the live-only collaborator image and the stall bound have their own scenarios (its header says why). 76 scenarios at about 34 lines against the plan's 69 at 25: collaborators, monitors, workflows, CLI workers and the context-wire bench each gained end-to-end scenarios after the plan, and the shared readers and step builders already live in drive.mjs and look.mjs; ext-codex-fast also covers the openai ChatGPT login, and the live smoke reads what agents ran on from their durable stores, since a lead on the openai login bypasses the request log; ext-chains drives a third turn to prove the 80% Chain reminder stops after one; Q5: the stall meter reads event-loop delay inside the lead from a polygon-only probe extension instead of a get_state round trip, which measured Pi 1.0.4's stdout backlog (+23); everything-at-once runs an 8-agent workflow under an active Mission that continues only after the last report, and its header says why it is still narrower (+8); model-lead-latest (+2) proves the default sol skips an openai API key and a set lead may use one; bench: Monitor says an Agent or Workflow already notifies, and ListAgents tells a lead with running tasks to end its turn instead of polling (+1); bench: subagents retry a 429 or 5xx 5 times, about 62 s, and wf-null-on-failure counts the retries (+1); bench: print-wait proves pi --print --mode json waits for a Workflow and an Agent to report and run that turn, and does not wait for a job without a timeout (+40)
